description: General purpose drive, standard control program, over the embedded fieldbus (EFB, Modbus RTU)
firmware: ASCKX 2.20 (the version the manual applies to)
source: ABB, "ACS580 standard control program firmware manual", 3AXD50000016097 revision J (2025-10-01); https://library.abb.com/d/3AXD50000016097

sources.title: ACS580 standard control program firmware manual

notes: Embedded fieldbus (terminals on the control unit), 58.01 Protocol enable = Modbus RTU. Defaults: node address 1, 19.2 kbit/s, 8 even 1.
Addresses are 1-based register numbers (400001 = 1). Parameters use 58.33 Addressing mode = Mode 0, the default.

Numeric parameters are read as 32-bit values (register 420000 + 200 × group + 2 × index) with the fixed FbEq32 scaling; their 16-bit copies at 400000 + 100 × group + index are scaled by group 46 for several signals and are not in this map.
32-bit values use 58.34 Word order = LO-HI (the default): low word first.
Lists, sources, bit words and data parameters are read as 16-bit values (400000 + 100 × group + index).
Parameters with an index above 99 (for example 58.101 Data I/O 1) are only reachable with addressing mode 1 or 2 and are not in this map.
Some units depend on settings: power in kW or hp and torque in N·m or lb·ft (96.16), temperatures in °C or °F.
Registers 1-14 carry the data selected by 58.101-58.114; the defaults are shown.
